Choosing between the AirPods 4 and AirPods Pro 3 basically comes down to a trade-off between fit, features, and price. Apple is also developing AirPods equipped with cameras that support Visual Intelligence, but these are not expected to launch until at least 2027, meaning the wait would be extremely long.

AirPods 4 emphasise comfort and value, offering different choices

The AirPods 4 feature an open design, making them a recommended option if you dislike in-ear earbuds. Our review of the AirPods 4 found that the redesigned shape provides a comfortable fit while maintaining the convenience of everyday use.

The $129 model is equipped with Apple's H2 chip, supports personalised spatial audio, and offers up to five hours of listening time. However, it lacks active noise cancellation, transparency mode, and wireless charging.

The $179 model adds useful active noise cancellation without needing to be inserted deep into the ear canal, and comes with adaptive audio, transparency mode, and a wireless charging case with a built-in Find My speaker.

The open design still lets in more ambient sound, so its active noise cancellation is less effective on aeroplanes and public transport.

AirPods Pro 3 offer a full suite of features

The AirPods Pro 3 are priced at $249 on Apple's website, with Amazon frequently offering discounts. The hybrid foam ear tips deliver stronger bass and noticeably better noise cancellation. According to Apple, battery life reaches up to eight hours with active noise cancellation enabled, compared to just four hours for the AirPods 4 with ANC on.

They can measure heart rate during workouts and support Apple's hearing test, hearing aid, and hearing protection features. Our review of the AirPods Pro 3 found that workout heart rate readings largely matched those of the Apple Watch.

Additionally, iOS 27 adds custom EQ functionality to both models, while the AirPods Pro 3 gain extra advantages thanks to the heart rate sensor and updated charging case.

Should you wait for AirPods with Visual Intelligence?

This week, AirPods equipped with Visual Intelligence were leaked early in a hidden video within the macOS Tahoe 26.7 candidate build. The footage appears to show someone using Siri with Visual Intelligence and camera-equipped AirPods to remember a book, sparking speculation of an imminent launch.

However, subsequent follow-up reports have refuted this claim. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reported that AirPods with cameras are still expected to launch in 2027. The B790 model shown in the video is reportedly a revised version of the AirPods Pro 3 that has been removed from Apple's 2026 roadmap. Apple is still developing the next-generation B798 model.

Which AirPods should you buy?

If price is your top priority and you don't need noise cancellation, the $129 AirPods 4 are a solid choice. If you strongly prefer an open fit, you can opt for the AirPods 4 with active noise cancellation.

For most other people, the AirPods Pro 3 remain the best buy, especially when Amazon discounts them to a price close to that of the AirPods 4 with active noise cancellation. They offer stronger noise cancellation, longer battery life, heart rate sensing, and Apple's hearing health features.

Today's AirPods pricing

  • AirPods 4 ($99, originally $129)
  • AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation ($148.99, originally $179)
  • AirPods Pro 3 ($189.99, originally $249)

Unless Visual Intelligence is absolutely essential to you, waiting does not make sense. Users who need to upgrade now and hold out for over a year will miss out on stronger noise cancellation, better battery life, and other practical features, all for the sake of an unannounced feature.

Otherwise, buy based on your current needs. The currently discounted AirPods already meet the practical requirements of most buyers, while future camera-equipped models will likely be priced higher or remain close to full price at launch.
